title: Variants leading to ELAVL2 haploinsufficiency cause a neurodevelopmental disorder with prominent cognitive; behavioral; and neurological features.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Ran paper_context.py: Europe PMC flags show no open access, no PMCID, no supplement, no full text, no GEO/SRA/BioProject links, no Zenodo/Dryad record. Only text-mined accessions are two fly stock IDs (RRID:BDSC_53340, RRID:BDSC_36304, Bloomington Drosophila Stock Center).
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: From the abstract only: 16 individuals with new (de novo) ELAVL2 variants (2 structural, 5 nonsense, 6 missense among the 13 from GeneMatcher, plus 3 taken from earlier cohort studies), clinical features, common-variant association results, fly loss-of-function experiments and protein-level assays.

a1_downloadable.note: No open full text, no supplement and no repository deposit found; patient-level clinical data in rare-disease case series is usually shared only on request. Checked via Europe PMC/NCBI metadata, not the files.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: No table of labelled examples exists; any label (pathogenic vs. benign, or phenotype) would have to be built from case descriptions.

a3_inputs_present.note: No data files located to inspect.

a5_enough_rows.note: 16 individuals (from the abstract), far below the ~400-row minimum for classification.

a6_fits_laptop.note: Anything that exists would be tiny.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: No download to compare with the paper.

a8_label_provenance.note: Clinical phenotypes and variant classes come from clinical sequencing and examination, not from a model; this does not rescue the other failures.

honest_claim_h3: With 16 patients and no deposited data, no model could support any claim beyond describing this one cohort.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use the DNA changes found in ELAVL2 patients to predict whether a change causes disease and which symptoms appear.
plain_idea.train_on: Each patient's ELAVL2 variant (type and position) and their clinical features; 16 patients, going by the abstract.
plain_idea.predict: Whether a variant causes disease, or which symptoms appear, based on clinical diagnosis and sequencing in the case series.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Clinical geneticists could use it to interpret new ELAVL2 variants, but 16 cases is far too few to learn anything.

ml_idea: None viable: a 16-patient rare-disease case series with no deposited data. At most it could add a handful of ELAVL2 variants to ClinVar-scale variant-effect benchmarks.

effort.compute_note: Not estimated; no data to model.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Patient count (16, from the abstract) is already below threshold.

verdict_reason: A case series of 16 patients with no open full text, supplement or repository deposit: it fails A1 (downloadable) and A5 (enough rows).
